source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The server server.ts drives tracker.ts for WhatsApp and signal-tracker.ts for Signal, which measure the response time of receipts. The React interface, made of Login and Dashboard in App.tsx, queries this server, and docker-compose.yml launches both.
